incident-bot: PagerDuty: PG-6734 fired -> p99 latency > 1200ms (eu-west) · SLO burn 42% · count 512 in 5m · pager -> @sre-oncall :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: acked. I’m on it, jumping into traces and infra dashboard now.

maria: saw a customer report from eu-west around 7:01 — correlates with the page.

jonah: looks like KV cache miss ratio spiked on the embedding sidecar (sidecar-embed). p50 fine, p99 blowout.

kevin: any deploys to eu-west in last 30m?

sre-oncall: nope, last deploy was 45m ago and green. No config changes.

ops-alerts: metric dump: 
```
series: 
  - cluster: eu-west-1
  - endpoint: /v1/embeddings
p99: 1298ms -> 1423ms
cache_miss: 12% -> 68%
gpu_util: 72% -> 94%
queue_depth: 4 -> 39
```

jonah: KV eviction cascade maybe — overheated hotkeys or large prefix churn. I’m SSHing to sidecar hosts to tail logs.

maria: product reports some customers seeing timeouts; severity -> possible partial degradation.

sre-oncall: mitigation path: 1) enable fallback routing to model-compact for non-critical routes 2) bump replica count on embedding pool 3) force KV warmup. Doing (1) now.

jonah: how do we enable fallback quickly?

sre-oncall: running rollback routing script: 
```
/run reroute --region eu-west --from model-embed-xl --to model-embed-compact --pct 60
```

incident-bot: command accepted, reroute started -> 60% traffic to model-embed-compact (ETA 30s).

kevin: initiating replica scale: 
```
kubectl scale deploy/embed-pool-eu --replicas=8 -n redwood-inference
```

ops-alerts: scale acknowledged by autoscaler, new pods coming up (3 -> 8).

jonah: tailing sidecar logs — seeing repeated KV eviction stacktraces and OOM-ish GC pauses right before latency spikes. Might need to tweak memory limits if new pods still thrash.

sre-oncall: rolling restart of sidecar set on one host to clear cache thrash: 
```
for node in eu-west-sidecar-0 eu-west-sidecar-1; do kubectl rollout restart ds/sidecar-$node; sleep 10; done
```

maria: notify support and customers in affected tenants? Product-ops, want to draft a short note?

product-ops: yes, prepping a limited customer bulletin: "We’re seeing elevated latency in eu-west for embeddings; routing to fallback models while we stabilize. No data loss expected. ETA 30-45m."

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PG-6734 acknowledged by sre-oncall (1718877724).

jonah: after reroute started p99 dropped from ~1400ms to ~550ms on the 60% routed traffic. Overall p99 now ~820ms. Cache miss still high on original pool.

sre-oncall: good signal. Continue to monitor — leaving 60% route for now and letting new pods warm. If p99 < 900ms for 5m we can reduce emergency actions.

kevin: new pods started but two of them show OOMKilled on startup logs — image needs memory bump. Opening a quick patch to increase sidecar memory limit.

jonah: pushing mem patch (increase to 6Gi) to staging -> then will roll to eu-west.

maria: support escalated two customers asking for SLA credit. Logging the impact window: start 1718877700. We’ll update once we have full restoration time.

incident-bot: Alert: scaling events + routing adjustments in progress. Autopager suppression set to true for this incident to avoid duplicate pages.

sre-oncall: mem patch applied to daemonset, new pods coming up with higher memory. Observability shows GC pause frequency dropping. p99 trending down to 420ms on routed traffic; overall p99 610ms.

jonah: KV warmup commands finished for primary pool. "kv_prefill --target embed_keys --parallel 12" took ~90s per shard.

kevin: monitoring GPU temp cycles — nothing alarming now.

product-ops: customer bulletin sent to affected tenants at 7:14 (internal ref INC-2391).

sre-oncall: excellent. Hold checklist: 
- confirm p99 < 800ms for 10m
- ensure no new OOMs
- keep 40-60% fallback route until stable
- update PD and close incident when stable for 20m

jonah: p99 remaining oscillation at 700-800ms when original pool receives traffic spikes. Might be residual hotkey pressure. Suggest setting short-term rate limit on heavy prefix routes.

sre-oncall: applying per-route rate limit (30rps) on top 3 heavy prefixes.

incident-bot: rate limit changes applied.

maria: support notes: customer A (tenant-112) saw 503s for 12 requests between 7:03-7:07. Customer B had timeouts but recovered after 7:12.

kevin: after mem bump and restart, OOMs stopped. new pod count healthy. queue_depth back to 6. cache_miss down to 18%. p99 now 430ms.

sre-oncall: holding in monitoring. If stable for 20m, plan to ramp fallback back down to normal routing. Last check: p99 420ms for 5m.

product-ops: starting incident write-up: root cause hypothesis: KV eviction cascade caused by sudden hotkey + insufficient sidecar memory leading to GC/OOM and p99 spike. Remediation: increase sidecar memory, autoscaling headroom, add hotkey backpressure, improve warmup prefill for embedders.

maria: start time 1718877700, partial restoration observed 1718877980, full stabilization observed 1718878540 (approx).

sre-oncall: handing off to next oncall at 1718878605 — leaving playbook and actions in INC-2391. Handoff notes: keep fallback at 30% for ramp down, watch for hotkey recurrence, follow up on long-term autoscale tweaks.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PG-6734 resolved by sre-oncall (1718878605).

maria: filing for SLA review and customer follow-ups. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
